tasks.label: npm: compile (vscode-extension)
tasks.detail: Build the vscode-extension: tsc (host TS) + vite build (webview SPA) -> vscode-extension/out

tasks.label: npm: watch (vscode-extension)
tasks.detail: Continuous build: tsc -watch + vite build --watch. Use with the 'Run Extension (watch)' launch config.

tasks.label: cargo: install host
tasks.detail: Dev workflow: install the host into ~/.cargo/bin via `cargo install --path`, so the extension resolves it from PATH (Tier 3) at the latest protocol version. Re-run after changing Rust code. For packaging (bundled bin/), use `npm run package` instead.
